answers.reason: The faculty administrative officer holds no office providing a seat in the senate.
Budget planning involves higher office holders and does not provide a seat for faculty administrative officers.
Appointment committees do not include faculty administrative officers by regulation.
Participation in the faculty council depends on office and rank, and the faculty administrative officer has no assigned seat.
The study commission is for academic matters and does not include the faculty administrative officer.
The faculty administrative officer organizes examinations and is involved in examination matters.
Internal research funding is directed at researchers rather than administrative officers.
Module revisions are handled by academic staff rather than administrative officers.
Laboratory equipment procurement is outside the remit of the faculty administrative officer.
Orientation week planning is for student onboarding rather than administrative office duties.
